svg.title: Example pool plan for 5,000 users
svg.desc: Four personas for 5,000 users. Call-center: 1,800 users and 1,200 at peak, pooled full desktop, 70 hosts at 18 sessions each, 67 hosts give 1,206 sessions if 3 are out. Business and mobile: 2,200 users and 1,100 at peak, pooled full desktop, 49 hosts at 24 sessions each, 46 hosts give 1,104 sessions if 3 are out. Developers: 700 users and 500 at peak, 700 assigned personal VMs. Specialists: 300 users and 240 at peak, 300 assigned personal GPU-capable VMs. In total 119 pooled plus 1,000 personal, 1,119 production VMs.
svg.text: Pooled full desktop; CRM + voice image
Capacity: 119 pooled hosts + 1,000 personal VMs = 1,119 production VMs.
Density and persona choices need acceptance testing. Temporary and recovery hosts are not counted.
